artifact_role: de-identified fitted complex-member protein-transition concordance model

complexes.name: WDR83:LAMTOR2:LAMTOR3:activated RAF:p-2S MAP2K:p-T,Y MAPK complex [endosome membrane]

fold_policy.assignment: SHA-256 ordered patient groups followed by balanced round-robin buckets

limitations: Held-patient held-member reconstruction is internal evaluation, not external validation.
Reactome membership does not establish assembly, activity, essentiality, stoichiometry, flux, or causality.
A rank-one factor is an explicit low-rank approximation and may underrepresent multi-state or antagonistic member behavior.
Missingness, source preprocessing, sampling, overlap between complexes, and cohort transport remain limitations.
Outputs are non-prescriptive and are not recurrence or treatment predictions.

training_recipe.bootstrap_seed_policy: first 64 SHA-256 bits of an explicit versioned seed-namespace digest and zero-based replicate index; the namespace binds source-file identity, complex order, complex membership, and training recipe, but excludes provenance prose
training_recipe.coordinate_identifiability: stored loading has Euclidean norm one; coordinate is rescaled inversely
training_recipe.factor_solver: deterministic alternating Huber IRLS with backtracking
training_recipe.held_member_evaluation: each finite member is masked and reconstructed from at least two other finite members in a held patient
training_recipe.input_transition: paired recurrent T2 minus primary T1 protein abundance
training_recipe.orientation: non-negative dot product with training source recurrence effect; lexical maximum-loading sign breaks exact zero ties
training_recipe.outer_assignment: SHA-256 ordered patient groups followed by balanced round-robin buckets
training_recipe.ridge_scale_balance: after each alternating sweep, apply the analytic reciprocal factor/loading rescaling that minimizes their two ridge terms without changing predictions
training_recipe.standardization: divide by training-only robust member scale without subtracting the training location
training_recipe.training_location: iterated Huber location, retained only as a baseline
